text: The dojo sharpens craft through patient repetition.
A low-rank adapter learns a small correction to a frozen model.
LoRA freezes the base weights and trains a compact delta.
Fine-tuning updates weights; embeddings map meaning to vectors.
Discipline and precision turn a novice into a master.
Gradient descent walks downhill toward a lower loss.
Attention lets the model weigh which tokens matter most.
A good dataset is worth more than a clever architecture.
